current_public_wording: OAuth/OIDC server and SDK with verification assets and security-test tooling; qualified release assurance inactive
future_allowed_wording: assumption-qualified formally verified and security-tested server and SDK for the profiles and artifacts identified in a qualified release assurance record
minimum_qualified_wording: State activated profiles, artifacts, assumptions/bounds, TCBs, and the release assurance record under aegaeon-assurance-statement-v1; core evidence alone is insufficient.
prohibited_wording: fully formally verified server and client without assumptions
formally verified OS entropy or host storage
formally verified compat algorithms outside the promoted profile

included_claim_boundaries.description: Server OIDC/OAuth protocol core in the assurance case.
Server-side RP / federation broker runtime support.
Verified Core checks claims, time, and replay semantics.
SDK implementation/output assurance requires C-01 through C-20 and reconciled release gates.

excluded_tcb_boundaries.description: Cryptographic hardness assumptions are theorem premises.
OS, device, HSM, KMS, and browser entropy are external.
Third-party runtime and platform dependencies are TCB.
External signature primitives may be TCB; SDK-owned preverification glue requires C-06/C-14/C-16 proof.
External IdPs, DNS, network, and TLS hosting are TCB.
External storage/hosting have explicit contracts; SDK coordination and callback validation remain proof obligations.
Compat-only algorithms remain outside the target.
Admin UI rendering and visual behaviour are excluded.

dependent_gates.description: Released client claim must be active first.
Client boundary must be promoted to released profile.
Client promotion gate must bind hosted release evidence.
Phase 4 public-activation blockers must be reviewed.

required_evidence.description: Server contract documentation is available; release-specific contract closure is a separate obligation.
Historical client-core evidence inventory is available; it does not establish SDK contract closure.
Client boundary freezes promoted and compat surfaces.
Released client claim gate is not active yet.
Hosted real-provider evidence must be fresh.
Fresh hosted admin SDK evidence passed without widening UI claims.
Publication custody and provenance must be complete.
Release security archive must bind required outputs.
Internal and external reviews must approve the wording.
Generated preflight inventories the current gate and blockers; it does not establish review approval.
Historical Phase 5 closure report is retained; it does not close the current assurance contracts.
Product positioning preserves future-gated TCB wording.
Complete SDK requirements, own-code proof, distributed-output correspondence and security testing under C-01 through C-20.
Complete server requirements, implementation/state proof, symbolic security, artifact binding and security testing under G-01 through G-18.
A qualified combined release record under aegaeon-assurance-statement-v1 establishes compatible interfaces, counterpart assumptions and composition evidence.
